findings.decision: Divide the remaining absolute deadline across pending server attempts. Each attempt and its TCP fallback use a child deadline that cannot extend the parent. Native tests cover a silent primary followed by a healthy secondary and a successful later pass over the same server. The caller deadline is shorter than queryTimeout.
SERVFAIL and REFUSED errors retain the selected responding endpoint. Two native peers reply in order; the exhausted error identifies the last peer.

Return mapped cancellation and total-deadline errors directly instead of losing endpoint diagnostics at the next retry checkpoint. A native peer cancels only after receiving the query; no query reaches the secondary. Per-attempt timeouts remain eligible for failover while the parent budget is live.

red.observation: The silent-primary case raises ResolveException at the exhausted parent deadline; the RCODE case loses the responding endpoint.

cancellation_red.stage: Intermediate worktree after deadline sharing and RCODE propagation, before terminal mapped-error handling
